title: How a Tailor-Made Tanzania Trip Works
excerpt: How does a tailor-made trip with Your Tanzania Trip work, from your first question to the moment you land in Tanzania?
body:
## 1. Your request

You fill in the [Plan your trip form](/travel-proposal/) with your dates, interests and travel style.

## 2. A conversation

We ask questions to understand what you want: pace, comfort, must-sees.

## 3. A proposal

Together with our local partner Kilimanjaro Nature Tours in Arusha, we put together a route, with lodges and a price confirmed by the partner.

## 4. Adjustments

You can change anything: an extra night, another lodge, a different park.

## 5. Booking

When you are happy, we book everything and send you the details.

## 6. Preparation

We help with practical questions: visa, packing, health.

## 7. On the ground

Our partner's team welcomes you at the airport and is available throughout the trip.

## Why local

See [why a local partner matters](/blog/why-a-local-partner-matters/) and [our partner](/our-partner/).
